items.name: VERCEL_TOKEN
items.reason: Required to deploy the Next.js VAPOR production web application to https://vapor-finance.vercel.app/ and verify live HTTP 200 responses.
items.secure_destination: Set environment variable VERCEL_TOKEN in local shell or .env file.
items.validation_method: Run `npx vercel Whoami --token=$VERCEL_TOKEN` and confirm non-empty user account.

items.name: CODEX_INDEPENDENT_PASS
items.reason: G20 may start only after the user invokes Codex and Codex independently passes the sealed G19 snapshot.
items.secure_destination: Record only the safe Codex verdict/evidence reference under docs/EVIDENCE/CODEX_HANDOFF; never include secrets.
items.validation_method: Verify verdict, source commit, graph hash, snapshot hash, and evidence hash match G19.

secret_handling: Store only the input name, purpose, secure destination, validation method, dependent nodes, and redacted evidence. Never store the value.
